commands.name: api
commands.description:
Perform CRUD operations on Magic Suite entities via the API.

AVAILABLE COMMANDS:
  get - List entities with filtering and pagination
  get-by-id      - Get a single entity by its ID
  create         - Create a new entity
  patch   - Update specific properties of an entity
  delete         - Delete an entity by ID
  export         - Export a complete entity configuration graph to a JSON document
  import         - Import a complete entity configuration graph from a JSON document

FIELD SELECTION:
  --select Id,Name,Status Select specific fields
  --select *  Select all fields

ORDERING:
  --orderby Id            Order by Id ascending (default)
  --orderby "Name asc"    Order by Name ascending
  --orderby "-Id"         Order by Id descending (prefix -)
  --orderby "+Name,-Id"   Order by Name asc, then Id desc

SUPER ADMIN:
  --include-all-tenants  Include entities from all tenants (requires super admin)
  --tenant <id|code>     Scope results to a specific tenant (requires super admin)

EXAMPLES:
  magicsuite api get tenants --select Id,Name,Code
  magicsuite api get connections --filter Logic --select Name,Type
  magicsuite api get reportmacroresults --filter ReportJobId:944 --select Id,ReportJobId,ExecutionResult
  magicsuite api get tenants --all-tenants --select Id,Name,Code
  magicsuite api get reportschedules --take 10 --orderby "-CreatedDateTime" --format json
  magicsuite api get tenants --include-all-tenants --select Id,Name,Code
  magicsuite api get reportschedules --tenant ABC --format json

commands.name: export
commands.description:
Export a complete entity configuration graph (all nested/child entities) as a single JSON document.

SUPPORTED ENTITY TYPES:
  eventmanager (aliases: integration, alertmagic); sync (alias: connectmagic).

For AlertMagic, the id is the EventManager (integration) id. Omit --version-id to export the
currently published/active version; pass --version-id to export a specific EventManagerVersion.

EXAMPLES:
  magicsuite api export eventmanager 42 --output cmp-eventmanager.jsonc
  magicsuite api export integration 42 --version-id 1234 --output v1234.jsonc
  magicsuite api export eventmanager 42            # write JSON to stdout

options.name: --version-id
options.description: Specific version id to export (AlertMagic: EventManagerVersion id). Defaults to the published/active version.

options.name: --tenant
options.description: Tenant three-letter code, ID, or GUID to export from (overrides the profile's current tenant)

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the JSON document to this file instead of stdout

arguments.name: ENTITY_TYPE
arguments.description: Entity type to export. eventmanager (aliases: integration, alertmagic); sync (alias: connectmagic).

arguments.name: ID
arguments.description: The id of the aggregate root to export (for AlertMagic, the EventManager id)

commands.name: import
commands.description:
Import a complete entity configuration graph (all nested/child entities) from a single JSON document.

SUPPORTED ENTITY TYPES:
  eventmanager (aliases: integration, alertmagic); sync (alias: connectmagic).

AlertMagic: pass the target EventManager (integration) id; the document is imported as a new
version of that EventManager (the version number is assigned by the server).

ConnectMagic (sync): the id is not required - the Sync is created, or a new version added to the
existing Sync with the same name in the artefact. Connections resolve by id then by name; use
--connection-map to override per connected system. The version is activated unless --no-activate.

EXAMPLES:
  magicsuite api import eventmanager 42 --file cmp-eventmanager.jsonc
  magicsuite api import sync --file cmp-sync.jsonc
  magicsuite api import sync --file cmp-sync.jsonc --connection-map "LM System=123" --connection-map "SNOW=Prod ServiceNow"
  magicsuite api import sync --file cmp-sync.jsonc --no-activate

options.name: --file
options.description: Path to the JSON document to import

options.name: --connection-map
options.description: ConnectMagic only: override a connected system's connection as "SystemName=<connectionId|Connection Name>" (repeatable). A numeric value is treated as a connection id, otherwise as a connection name.

options.name: --no-activate
options.description: ConnectMagic only: import the version without making it the Sync's active version. [default: False]

options.name: --tenant
options.description: Tenant three-letter code, ID, or GUID to import into (overrides the profile's current tenant)

arguments.name: ENTITY_TYPE
arguments.description: Entity type to import. eventmanager (aliases: integration, alertmagic); sync (alias: connectmagic).

arguments.name: ID
arguments.description: For AlertMagic, the target EventManager id to add a version to. Not used for sync (Sync is resolved by name). [default: 0]

Manage files and folders in Magic Suite file system.

  list         - List files and folders
  upload       - Upload a local file to Magic Suite
  download     - Download a file from Magic Suite

commands.name: merlin
commands.description:
Converse with Merlin from the command line.

Uses the same API endpoint and message history as the web chat panel, so what you
see here is what a user would see in the browser.

commands.name: chat
commands.description:
Start a conversation with Merlin against the environment in your current CLI profile.

INTERACTIVE MODE (no --prompt or --script):
  Type a message and press Enter. Meta-commands:
    /new            Start a genuinely fresh session (clears all history)
    /raw            Toggle display of the raw request and response JSON
    /history        Show the message history that would be posted next
    /save <file>    Save the transcript so far to a Markdown file
    /help           Show these commands
    /exit           Leave (Ctrl+C also works)

SCRIPTED MODE (--prompt or --script):
  Each prompt is sent in turn within one session, and the replies printed.
  Use --new-session-per-prompt to start each prompt in a fresh session instead,
  which is how you compare first-turn behaviour across questions.

EXAMPLES:
  magicsuite merlin chat
  magicsuite merlin chat --profile test2
  magicsuite merlin chat --prompt "Please come up with some macros that could create graphs on my reports"
  magicsuite merlin chat --script conversation.txt --transcript evidence.md
  magicsuite merlin chat --script questions.txt --new-session-per-prompt --raw

options.name: --prompt
options.description: A prompt to send. Repeat for a multi-turn scripted conversation.

options.name: --script
options.description: File of prompts, one per line. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

options.name: --transcript
options.description: Write the conversation transcript to this Markdown file on exit.

options.name: --new-session-per-prompt
options.description: Start a fresh session for each scripted prompt instead of one continuous conversation. [default: False]

options.name: --raw
options.description: Show the raw request and response JSON for every turn. [default: False]

options.name: --user-name
options.description: Display name to stamp on your messages in the transcript (default: User).
